title: Universal Assembly and Cellular Loop Spaces on Regular CW Complexes
summary: We develop a regular CW analogue of the classical assembly formalism for chain complexes appearing in algebraic surgery theory. From the cell poset, we construct combinatorial path and loop objects using fences of comparable cells and prove that their classifying spaces recover the homotopy types of the ordinary based path and loop spaces. The resulting loop object carries a natural monoid structure, giving rise to a DG algebra defined directly from the cellular structure.
